evidence.name: Screen field: Size of the error text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Size of the error text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Size of the error text
sections.description: Sets the point size of the validation error message. Keep it a touch smaller than the field text (about 12-13pt) so it reads as a secondary note, but not so small it's hard to read on a phone. A legible error helps users spot and fix a rejected answer instead of abandoning the screen.
